stories.headline: I'm Taking the Commissioner, Laying 82.5 With Send Nudes, and Setting My Alarm for Paris
intro: Thursday night I had the Patriots plus 2.5 and a feeling. The Bears won 30-24 and the feeling turned out to be indigestion. Caleb Williams put 22.12 on the board for Stroke The Post, D'Andre Swift added 19.0, and Luther Burden III dropped 23.7 on Sheev's side of the ledger. Drake Maye threw for ClutchJuice's entire week, 28.44, in a loss. Colston Loveland gave Very Naughty Boys 19.9, Eli Raridon gave Panic Trade Project 14.6, and A.J. Brown gave Send Nudes 7.8, which is what you get from a Patriot in Chicago in October.

Same system as always. Every Sunday and Monday starter gets the Vegas implied total for his offense, built from the spread and the total. I took Saturday's boards from CBS Sports (DraftKings), FOX Sports and VegasInsider and lined them up. The only real fight is Bengals at Ravens: CBS had Cincinnati by 1.5, FOX had Baltimore by 1.5, and VegasInsider had Cincinnati by 3. The books can't agree on a favorite, so I'm calling it a pick'em at 47.5, 23.75 a side. Lamar Jackson is out again, and that's the whole reason the number moved.

The board in one breath. Detroit is implied for 28.5 against Green Bay in a 53.5 game, the fattest number of the week. Houston is 26.25 against the Giants, San Francisco 26, the Rams 25.75 in Las Vegas, Green Bay 25. The sewer: the Giants at 16.25, Tennessee at 17 in a 36.5 total that should be played in a parking garage, Miami and Indianapolis at 17.5, Cleveland and Arizona at 19.5, Kansas City at 19.75. Buffalo, Jacksonville, the Chargers and Washington are on bye, which is why Josh Allen, Trevor Lawrence, Justin Herbert and Jayden Daniels are all sitting on benches today. Saints and Steelers kick off in Paris at 8:30 a.m. Central. Set your lineups before your coffee, you animals.

sections.note: Ben Football Team. Jared Goff and Sam LaPorta are in the 28.5-point Detroit offense, and two Ben quarterbacks out-project God Bless Vodka's two by 6.4.
p: The closest number on the board. Ben Football Team is 5-1 with the league's highest luck factor, +2.36, scoring 125.4 a game, seventh. God Bless Vodka is 1-5 and has lost five straight. Sleeper has these lineups 0.8 apart. If you want to know what 0.8 points looks like, it's a kicker's extra point and a sigh.

Here's why I'm on Ben. Superflex is a quarterback league and Ben has the better pair. Goff projects 19.94 in the Packers-Lions game, Detroit implied for 28.5, and Patrick Mahomes adds 16.3 in Seattle. God Bless Vodka counters with Geno Smith (16.4) against Miami and Cam Ward (13.4) in Tennessee, where the Titans are implied for 17. That's a 6.4-point head start before a running back touches the ball. Ben also has LaPorta (13.4) in the same Detroit game, so Goff touchdowns can pay twice.

God Bless Vodka's case is real, which is why this is the game of the week. It has three starters in 25-plus offenses to Ben's two: Nico Collins in Houston (26.25) against a Giants secondary missing Jevon Holland and Greg Newsome, George Kittle in San Francisco (26) with Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel both out, and Jameson Williams on the other side of Goff in Detroit. Tyler Allgeier gets the Arizona backfield with Jeremiyah Love out again. Josh Downs gets more looks in Minnesota with Tyler Warren out.

Ben's soft spots: Chuba Hubbard and Chris Godwin are on opposite sides of Bucs-Panthers, Denzel Boston is in the Cleveland offense at 19.5, and DK Metcalf is in Paris. But Godwin gets Baker Mayfield back and Emeka Egbuka is out, so Godwin moves up the target line. I'm laying the 0.8 and praying to a God who, judging by this team's record, does not bless vodka.

sections.note: Sheev. 29.3 already banked, two quarterbacks in 26-plus offenses against #StopAsianHate's one in a 36.5 total, and a dead lineup spot on the other side unless somebody wakes up.
p: The commissioner is a 3.8-point underdog and I'm taking him. I'm not doing it to get my dues waived. I'm doing it because the matchup is screaming. Sheev is 1-5 with the worst luck factor in the league, -2.82. Its all-play record says it should have about four wins. #StopAsianHate is 2-4, second-worst luck at -2.18. Two teams that got robbed, one of them is getting paid today, and these are the same two teams that made the Week 4 trade: Kenneth Walker III to #StopAsianHate, Quinshon Judkins plus #StopAsianHate's 2028 first and second to Sheev. Both guys start today.

Start with the money already in the bank. Sheev has 29.3 from Thursday, 23.7 of it from Burden. Then look at quarterback, which in superflex is everything. Sheev starts C.J. Stroud (18.41) in Houston, implied for 26.25 as a 10-point favorite over a Giants defense that just lost Tremaine Edmunds for the year and is also missing Holland and Newsome. It starts Brock Purdy (20.58) in San Francisco, implied for 26. That's 39.0 projected from two quarterbacks.

#StopAsianHate starts one quarterback. Lamar Jackson is out, Jalen Hurts is on IR, so it's Deshaun Watson (14.28) in the lowest total on the board, 36.5, Cleveland implied for 19.5. The superflex spot goes to RJ Harvey, a running back. Sheev's quarterbacks out-project that by 24.7, and that's before we talk about Rashee Rice, who is out with his hamstring and knee and was still in the lineup when the data dropped this morning. Kansas City doesn't play until Sunday night, so they have time to fix it, but the best bench options are Cam Skattebo and Tyrone Tracy in the 16.25-point Giants offense, Kenny Gainwell in Tampa and Tyler Higbee, a $1 pickup on Friday.

Now the rest of their lineup. Zay Flowers (16.79) catches passes from Tyler Huntley. Dallas Goedert gets more targets with DeVonta Smith out, but they come from Tanner McKee on Monday night, Philadelphia implied for 20. Walker plays Seattle, his old team, with Kansas City implied for 19.75. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (24.06) is the best player in this game, and I'll give them that. But Sheev has Isaiah Likely as the only healthy tight end in New York with Theo Johnson out, and the Giants should be throwing all day from 10 down. Tetairoa McMillan is in a Carolina offense at 23.75 against a Tampa secondary missing Antoine Winfield Jr. The risk is Breece Hall, questionable with the quad after missing three games. If he sits, ClutchJuice's Braelon Allen eats and Sheev needs a pivot by noon. I'm taking the points and the commissioner. I'm betting my watch, and it's a nice watch.

sections.note: Stroke The Post. It has 41.12 banked and two Cowboys on Monday night. brimley has the toughest schedule in the league and draws the highest-scoring lineup it could find.
p: Thursday's edition called this the game of the week. Then Caleb Williams and D'Andre Swift put up 41.12 on Thursday night and it turned into a bloodbath. Stroke The Post is 4-2, scores 171.1 a game, third in the league, and is a 24.3-point favorite. brimley is 3-3, scores 151.4, fourth, and has faced 165.5 a game, the toughest schedule in the league. The schedule-maker hates this team, and it's about to happen again.

Stroke's remaining eight are all over the map, and the map is pretty good. CeeDee Lamb (17.28) and Javonte Williams (17.84) are on the Monday night favorite, Dallas implied for 24.5 against an Eagles team missing DeVonta Smith and starting McKee. Matthew Stafford (17.35) is in the Rams' 25.75 offense, though if Puka Nacua sits with the calf his best target is gone. Drake London is in Atlanta at 23.5 against a San Francisco defense without Nick Bosa. Chris Olave is in Paris. Jonathan Taylor is the soft spot: 17.6 projected in Minnesota with the Colts implied for 17.5 as a 6.5-point dog.

brimley has the best quarterback spot on the board and it isn't close: Jordan Love (19.83) and Christian Watson (18.05) in the 53.5-point Packers-Lions game, Green Bay implied for 25. Justin Jefferson gets a Colts secondary without Sauce Gardner. Bucky Irving gets Baker Mayfield back. That's the upside. The downside is Jacoby Brissett in Arizona at 19.5, Tony Pollard in Tennessee at 17, Malik Nabers in the 16.25-point Giants offense, and Saquon Barkley, questionable on Monday night after a full practice late in the week.
brimley's whole lineup projects 149.6. Stroke's remaining eight project 132.8 on top of the 41.12 already in the bank. The Packers stack can win a lot of games by itself. Not this one. Lay the 24.3.

sections.note: Bijan Your Face 🍆💦. Christian McCaffrey and Amon-Ra St. Brown are in 26-plus offenses, Bijan Robinson has the Atlanta backfield to himself, and Jackie's 4-2 is built on the softest schedule in the league.
p: The last unbeaten team goes for 7-0. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 scores 184.8 a game, best in the league, and projects 169.9 with Josh Allen on a bye. Jackie aCHANe is 4-2, has faced 86.7 a game, the softest schedule in the league, and has a +2.0 luck factor, second-highest. Last week it lost to Send Nudes by 0.14. This week it gets the other heavyweight. That's 56.3 points of spread, and that's not a line, that's a restraining order.

Look at what Bijan starts. Bijan Robinson (23.93) gets an Atlanta backfield with Brian Robinson out and a 49ers defense without Bosa. On the other side of that game, McCaffrey (21.04) is in the 26-point San Francisco offense and gets extra targets with Evans and Deebo both out. Amon-Ra St. Brown (20.28) is in Detroit at 28.5. Brock Bowers and Ashton Jeanty are in Las Vegas at 22.75, Josh Jacobs is in Green Bay at 25, and Dak Prescott closes it out on Monday night in the 24.5-point Dallas offense.

Jackie has three starters in 25-plus offenses too. Woody Marks gets Houston's backfield with David Montgomery out, Houston implied for 26.25. Matthew Golden and Tucker Kraft are in the Packers' 25. Bryce Young is at home against Tampa, Carolina implied for 23.75. But it also starts Zachariah Branch at 3.01 projected, Zonovan Knight and Kendrick Bourne in the 19.5-point Arizona offense, and Wan'Dale Robinson in Tennessee. Seven straight. I'll lay it.

sections.note: Send Nudes. Jahmyr Gibbs alone is 26.37 projected in the best offense on the board, and ClutchJuice already spent its whole week on Thursday.
p: ClutchJuice leads 28.44 to 7.8. Enjoy it, kids. That's Drake Maye's Thursday night, and that's the whole show. The rest of ClutchJuice's lineup projects 60.0 combined. Isaiah Davis is projected for 0.41. Braelon Allen is projected for 7.39, and if Breece Hall plays, Allen gets the scraps. Darius Cooper picks up targets in Philadelphia with DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks out, but they're McKee targets. Rashod Bateman catches from Huntley. Zero ClutchJuice starters are in an offense implied for 25.

Send Nudes has three. Gibbs (26.37) is in Detroit at 28.5. Kyren Williams (19.81) and Puka Nacua (22.25) are in the Rams' 25.75. Joe Burrow and Ja'Marr Chase are a stack in the pick'em game in Baltimore, and the Bengals have no players on the injury report. Derrick Henry gets a Bengals defense in a game his own team can't decide whether it's favored in. Send Nudes projects 170.9.

The only question is Puka, a game-time decision with the calf after leaving Thursday's practice and sitting out Friday. The Rams play at 3:25 Central, so whatever Send Nudes does, it needs a late-window pivot ready. Even if Puka posts a zero, the line is 60-plus. Send Nudes, five straight wins, sixth one today. I'd bet the house, but the house is already in the Paris parlay.

sections.note: Very Naughty Boys. Panic Trade Project starts two players projected for 3.75 combined, and Very Naughty Boys finally has a lineup with no holes.
p: Two of the three lowest-scoring teams in the league, 197.6 projected between them, and a 0.6-point spread. Panic Trade Project is 3-3 on 91.9 a game, 10th, with the third-highest luck factor, +1.82. Very Naughty Boys is 0-6 and scores 86.0, last. Somebody's going to win this. That's the most I can say for it.

Thursday was a wash: Panic got 25.5 from Raridon and Rome Odunze, Very Naughty Boys got 25.2 from Loveland and DeMario Douglas. Loveland's role may be about to grow, because Cole Kmet was carted off Thursday with a knee injury. Now look at Panic's Sunday. Kaleb Johnson is projected for 0.23. Marvin Harrison Jr. is projected for 3.52. Technically that's two starters in 25-plus offenses, Green Bay and Houston, and they're projected for 3.75 combined. Tyjae Spears is questionable with the knee in a Tennessee offense implied for 17.

Panic does have the best player in the game, Bo Nix (19.23), in Arizona with Denver implied for 24 as a 4.5-point favorite. Jalen Coker (15.63) is in Carolina at 23.75. But Very Naughty Boys has eight real players left: Sam Darnold on Sunday night, J.K. Dobbins and Jonah Coleman in that same Denver backfield, Jordan Addison in the Vikings' 24, and McKee on Monday night. Coleman is questionable with the ankle, but if he sits, Dobbins gets more work. Nobody in this matchup deserves a win. Very Naughty Boys gets its first one anyway. I'll take the 0.6. Don't tell anybody.

stories.headline: Lamar Is Out, Puka Is a Game-Time Call, and One Lineup Still Has Rashee Rice in It
paragraphs: Good morning. The early game is in Paris, Steelers at Saints, at 8:30 a.m. Central, so the first inactives come out around 7:00. Every other inactive list comes about 90 minutes before its kickoff. As always, a designation tells you the risk. It doesn't tell you who sits.

Quarterbacks first. Lamar Jackson (#StopAsianHate bench) was downgraded to out with his high ankle sprain and misses a third straight game. Tyler Huntley starts again, and Cincinnati-Baltimore is a pick'em at about 47.5. That downgrade reaches Derrick Henry (Send Nudes), Zay Flowers (#StopAsianHate), Ja'Kobi Lane (Panic Trade Project) and Rashod Bateman (ClutchJuice). Jalen Hurts (#StopAsianHate) is still on IR, so Tanner McKee (Very Naughty Boys) starts Monday night against Dallas. Dillon Gabriel is out with his back, so Deshaun Watson starts for Cleveland, and he is again the only quarterback #StopAsianHate has in its lineup. The good news is Baker Mayfield (Send Nudes bench), who has been out since Week 3. He's officially questionable with the thumb, but he's expected to start at Carolina, which helps Chris Godwin Jr. (Ben Football Team) and Bucky Irving (brimley).

One lineup needs attention. Rashee Rice (#StopAsianHate) is out with hamstring and knee injuries and was still in the starting lineup when this morning's data was pulled. Kansas City plays Sunday night, so there's time to make the change.

San Francisco is without Mike Evans (ribs and Achilles) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring). Both belong to Send Nudes. Christian Kirk (Send Nudes bench) is listed questionable but practiced fully. The targets go to George Kittle (God Bless Vodka) and Christian McCaffrey (Bijan Your Face 🍆💦), with Brock Purdy (Sheev) throwing to a thinner group. In Philadelphia, DeVonta Smith (Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 IR) and Dontayvion Wicks (Very Naughty Boys) are both out, which leaves more for Dallas Goedert (#StopAsianHate) and Darius Cooper (ClutchJuice). Tyler Warren (Send Nudes IR) is out for Indianapolis, which should help Josh Downs (God Bless Vodka). Theo Johnson is out for the Giants, so Isaiah Likely (Sheev) is their tight end. Emeka Egbuka (Panic Trade Project) is out with a concussion and a foot injury.

Backfields. David Montgomery (Jackie aCHANe bench) is out, so Woody Marks (Jackie aCHANe) leads Houston's backfield. Jeremiyah Love (God Bless Vodka bench) misses a second straight game, which leaves Tyler Allgeier (God Bless Vodka) and Zonovan Knight, a $3 Jackie aCHANe pickup on Thursday. Brian Robinson Jr. (brimley bench) is out, which leaves more work for Bijan Robinson. Zach Charbonnet (Sheev bench) is out again after coming off PUP.

The questionable list. Puka Nacua (Send Nudes) is a true game-time decision with a calf injury. He left Thursday's practice early, sat out Friday, and reports say the injury isn't considered major. The Rams play at 3:25 Central, so whoever starts him needs a pivot from the late window. Breece Hall (Sheev) practiced in a limited way Thursday after missing three games with the quad. Saquon Barkley (brimley) logged a full practice late in the week and is questionable for Monday. Tyjae Spears (Panic Trade Project), Jonah Coleman (Very Naughty Boys) and Rico Dowdle (Stroke The Post bench) are also questionable. Tank Dell (Sheev bench), a $1 pickup, is expected back for Houston after about 22 months away with his knee injury. On Thursday, Cole Kmet was carted off with a knee injury that may end his season, which leaves Colston Loveland (Very Naughty Boys) as Chicago's tight end.

On the good side: the Bengals have nobody on the injury report, so Joe Burrow and Ja'Marr Chase (Send Nudes) and Chase Brown and Tee Higgins have a clean bill of health. Caleb Williams (Stroke The Post), questionable last week, played Thursday and scored 22.12. Check inactives before every window. Your lineup has more bad news in it than you think.

lead.headline: $37 for a Backup: #StopAsianHate Breaks the Bank on Tyrone Tracy
lead.deck: The biggest winning bid of the season buys a running back projected for 6.64. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 wins a five-team fight for Michael Mayer, and Sheev pays $11 for the receiver Send Nudes cut.

stories.headline: Thirty-Seven Dollars and a Depth Chart
paragraphs: Wednesday's run cleared eight claims for $88, and #StopAsianHate spent $37 of it on one player: Giants running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. That's the biggest winning bid in this league all season, two dollars past the $35 Very Naughty Boys paid for Tanner McKee last Friday. Panic Trade Project bid $17 and Send Nudes bid $7, so #StopAsianHate overpaid the field by $20. Here's what bothers me. Sleeper has Tracy second on New York's depth chart, he projects 6.64 this week, and he isn't in #StopAsianHate's lineup. That's a bet on a job opening up, made by a 2-4 team that cut Efton Chism III to do it, and it leaves #StopAsianHate with $38.

The most contested claim of the run was Michael Mayer, and five teams wanted him. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 won at $13 over Panic ($9), #StopAsianHate ($9), Jackie aCHANe ($3) and Stroke The Post ($1). The Stroke bid is the story inside the story: Stroke had Mayer until Saturday, cut him to claim Tua Tagovailoa for $12, and bid $1 on Wednesday to get him back. It lost. Mayer is the No. 2 tight end in Las Vegas behind Brock Bowers, who starts for Bijan and is questionable. The only unbeaten team in the league just bought its own starter's backup, and it still has $70. That's my best value of the week.

Bijan also paid $6 for Dallas receiver Ryan Flournoy, beating Jackie's $2, and cut Kyle Juszczyk, whom it had claimed for $2 on Monday. Its $2 claim on Chig Okonkwo failed for lack of roster space. Sheev paid $11 for Courtland Sutton, the receiver Send Nudes released on Oct. 14, and the only other bid was Stroke's $2. Sheev overpaid by $9, but Sutton goes straight into its lineup at 9.02 projected against Arizona. Sheev cut Kayshon Boutte and is down to $15.

Very Naughty Boys kept shopping. It paid $6 for Treylon Burks over Bijan's $3, and Burks is on bye with Washington this week. It also claimed Jahan Dotson for $5 with no competing bid, and Dotson starts right away at 5.51. Its $2 claim on Roschon Johnson failed for roster space. On Tuesday, the 0-6 team also traded Chris Godwin Jr. and Justin Fields for Dontayvion Wicks and sold Anthony Richardson Sr. for a fifth-round pick. Mona Lott grades both below. VNB has $26 left.

Panic Trade Project paid $8 for Joe Milton, uncontested, and cut Jalon Daniels. Sleeper lists Milton third on Philadelphia's depth chart with no projection, so Panic is still starting a receiver, Ja'Kobi Lane, in its superflex slot. Panic lost the Tracy and Mayer auctions and has $17. Then there's Send Nudes, which went in a circle. On Monday it cut Sione Vaki to claim Brandin Cooks for $4. On Tuesday it released Cooks. On Wednesday it claimed Vaki back for $2. That's $6 to end the week where it started, and the champs can afford it.

From the weekend runs: Very Naughty Boys' $35 for McKee has already paid off, with 12.6 points in Week 6 and a 14.4 projection this week as its superflex. brimley paid $8 for Kendre Miller over Very Naughty Boys ($2) and Sheev ($1). Send Nudes claimed Christian Kirk for $7. Ben Football Team claimed Tyler Higbee for $7 on Saturday and released him Tuesday. Sheev claimed Tank Dell for $1 two days after Panic cut him, and Dell is on injured reserve.

Who has money left: Send Nudes $104, God Bless Vodka $96, brimley $74, Bijan $70, Stroke $69 and Ben $63. Then it falls off: #StopAsianHate $38, Very Naughty Boys $26, Panic $17, Sheev $15, Jackie $14 and ClutchJuice $9. The two teams with the best records and the most money are 5-1 Send Nudes and 6-0 Bijan. If a starting running back goes down this weekend, one of them gets him.

stories.headline: Lions Night, Bench Holes and the Unluckiest Game in the League
paragraphs: No picks in this column. Jeff Longwood makes those Sunday, once the injury report settles. This is the scouting file for Week 7. Buffalo, Jacksonville, the Chargers and Washington are on bye. The only bye-week starter in a league lineup as of Thursday morning is Jackie aCHANe's Jakobi Meyers in Jacksonville.

Tonight it's New England at Chicago. The Bears are favored by 3 to 3.5 with a total of 50.5 to 51, which implies about 26.75 points for Chicago, the second-most of the week. Ten league starters play. Stroke The Post has Caleb Williams and D'Andre Swift. Sheev has TreVeyon Henderson and Luther Burden III. Panic Trade Project has Rome Odunze and Eli Raridon. Very Naughty Boys has DeMario Douglas and Colston Loveland. Send Nudes has A.J. Brown, and ClutchJuice has Drake Maye, whose 21.58 projection is the highest of any quarterback in a league lineup.

Follow the implied totals. Green Bay at Detroit has the week's biggest total, 53.5, with the Lions favored by 3. That implies about 28.25 points for Detroit, the most of the week, and 25.25 for Green Bay. Eleven league starters play in that game, including Jahmyr Gibbs, whose 25.24 is the top projection in the league. Houston (26.5, as 10.5-point favorites over the Giants) and the Rams (26.5 at Las Vegas) are next. At the bottom are the Giants at 16, then Miami and Indianapolis at 17.5. Jackie has four starters in offenses implied for 25 or more, the most in the league, but one is David Montgomery, who is questionable with no projection. ClutchJuice has none. brimley's starters average 21.0 implied points, the lowest in the league. Our two sources disagree on the favorite in Cincinnati at Baltimore and San Francisco at Atlanta, so we're treating both as pick'ems.

The game of the week is brimley against Stroke The Post, because it's a playoff-line game. Stroke is 4-2. brimley is 3-3 and holds sixth only on points over Panic. Stroke projects 166.0 to 148.9 and leads at receiver by 10.4 and running back by 8.0. brimley's problem is the injury report: five of its starters are questionable, Bucky Irving, Justin Jefferson, Christian Watson, Saquon Barkley and Jordan Love, and together they're 84.69 of its 148.9 projected points. No team has more questionable starters. brimley has also allowed 165.5 a game, the most in the league.

Lineup holes, as of Thursday morning. Jackie aCHANe has Meyers (bye) and Montgomery (no projection) in its flex slots and starts Daniel Jones (10.71) at quarterback, with Kyler Murray (16.34), Malik Willis (14.6) and AJ Barner (7.43) on its bench. That's about 16 points sitting there. God Bless Vodka starts Jeremiyah Love, who is questionable with no projection. Swap in Tyler Allgeier (11.46) and it projects 131.1, ahead of Ben Football Team's 129.8. Very Naughty Boys has Jonah Coleman, who is on injured reserve, in a running back slot. ClutchJuice has running back Demond Claiborne (0.64) in its superflex slot, and Anthony Richardson Sr., its new quarterback, has no projection.

Last, the bad-luck game. Sheev is 1-5 and #StopAsianHate is 2-4, and by all-play they're the two unluckiest teams in the league. Sheev has played like a 3.82-win team and #StopAsianHate like a 4.18-win team. Both score more than 148 a game. #StopAsianHate projects 156.9 to 125.3, and almost all of that edge is at receiver, 66.6 to 35.6, led by Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 23.48, the top receiver projection in the league. Sheev has the better quarterbacks, C.J. Stroud and Brock Purdy, by 4.7.

stories.headline: Two Games Decided by Less Than a Point, and Four Losers Who Had the Answer on the Bench
intro: Week 6 in one sentence: four NFL teams were on bye, scoring fell to its lowest level of the season, and the lineup decisions mattered more than ever. The league averaged 120.68 points, the lowest of any week this year, and the week's top score, Stroke The Post's 151.98, is the lowest top score of any week.

Four losers had a winning lineup on their own rosters: Jackie aCHANe, Very Naughty Boys, #StopAsianHate and God Bless Vodka. Bijan Your Face is 6-0. Send Nudes and Ben Football Team are 5-1, and Stroke The Post and Jackie aCHANe are 4-2. brimley and Panic Trade Project are both 3-3, and brimley holds the sixth and final playoff spot on points scored, 908.46 to 551.32. #StopAsianHate and ClutchJuice are a game back at 2-4. Here is every game.

p: Send Nudes won 118.34 to 118.2. The 0.14-point margin is the closest game of the season, and the champions did it without four of their best players: Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase and Jahmyr Gibbs were on bye, and Tyler Warren is listed out. Send Nudes' best possible lineup was 118.34, so for the second straight week it left nothing on the bench.

The fill-ins carried it. Kirk Cousins scored 19.52 at superflex, Aaron Rodgers 17.02 at quarterback, Keenan Allen 16.2 on a 9.59 projection and Rachaad White 15.7 on 10.98. The stars underneath were quiet: Kyren Williams scored 9.7 against a 21.03 projection, Derrick Henry 5.0 against 17.68 and Puka Nacua 14.0 against 22.64. Send Nudes was projected for 155.9 on Sunday and scored 37.56 fewer.

Jackie aCHANe will be thinking about one decision. Terry McLaurin started and scored 3.7, and he is now listed out with a knee injury. Bryce Lance scored 8.9 on the bench. That swap alone makes it 123.4 to 118.34, a Jackie win. Matthew Golden scored 22.4 and Bryce Young 19.84, and Jackie scored only 2.07 fewer than its starters' projected total of 120.27. It lost by less than the 5.5 it left on the bench.
sections.note: Send Nudes has won five straight and is 5-1 with 1,059.18 points, second in the league. Jackie aCHANe falls to 4-2.

p: Very Naughty Boys scored 114.42, its best score of the season by 16.76, and lost by 0.54. It was a 32.5-point underdog on Sunday's lineup projections and beat its starters' projected total of 89.16 by 25.26.

The loss was on the bench. Very Naughty Boys claimed Tanner McKee for $35 on Thursday and started him at superflex, where he scored 12.6. J.J. McCarthy scored 17.32 on the bench. That one swap is worth 4.72 points, and the game was decided by 0.54. On Monday afternoon Very Naughty Boys also traded a 2027 fourth-round pick to God Bless Vodka for Austin Ekeler and started him. He scored 2.7. The good news was real: DeMario Douglas, a $1 claim on Thursday, scored 19.6 on a 4.28 projection, Colston Loveland scored 18.5 and J.K. Dobbins 13.6.

Ben Football Team won while scoring 6.27 below its starters' projected total of 121.23. Bhayshul Tuten scored 24.7, DK Metcalf 20.3 after his 5.3 debut, and Chuba Hubbard 19.1. Its quarterbacks combined for 19.96: Patrick Mahomes scored 11.48 on an 18.61 projection and Jameis Winston 8.48. Ben's last two wins have come by 4.56 and 0.54.
sections.note: Ben Football Team is 5-1 with the seventh-most points in the league and the best luck rating, +2.36. Very Naughty Boys is 0-6.

p: brimley was a 9.8-point underdog on Sunday's lineup projections and won 141.48 to 128.86, the second-highest score of the week. Malik Nabers scored 28.5 on a 14.17 projection and Trevor Lawrence 28.34 on 18.21. Jordan Love added 21.24 and Dameon Pierce 15.0. MarShawn Lloyd scored 1.0 on a 12.33 projection while Stefon Diggs scored 16.4 on the bench, but brimley did not need him.

#StopAsianHate had the win on its roster. Cam Skattebo started at superflex and scored 0.0 against a 12.04 projection, and Blake Corum scored 14.0 on the bench. That swap makes it 142.86 to 141.48. #StopAsianHate also got 3.6 from Rhamondre Stevenson against a 15.01 projection and 9.46 from Deshaun Watson at quarterback. Kenneth Walker scored 27.9 and Jaxon Smith-Njigba 25.4, and #StopAsianHate banked 40.0 from Smith-Njigba and RJ Harvey on Thursday night. It was not enough.
After the game, brimley traded Jonathon Brooks to Panic Trade Project for Tre Tucker. Mona Lott grades it below.
sections.note: brimley has won two straight and holds sixth place at 3-3. #StopAsianHate has lost three straight and is 2-4.

p: Bijan Your Face won 137.12 to 103.5 and is the only unbeaten team left. It was a 92.9-point favorite on Sunday's projections and won by 33.62. Its 137.12 is its lowest score of the season. Christian McCaffrey scored 30.7, the best score by any starter in the league this week, and DeVonta Smith added 20.5.

The rest underdelivered. Bijan Robinson scored 7.3 against a 25.12 projection, Davante Adams 6.9 against 16.63 and Josh Allen 18.3 against 24.96. Tyler Shough scored 26.96 on the bench, the best bench score in the league, while Dak Prescott scored 13.02 at superflex. Bijan left 22.34 on the bench and still won by 33.62.

ClutchJuice played a perfect lineup, 103.5 points, and beat its starters' projected total of 77.33 by 26.17, the largest overperformance in the league this week. Germie Bernard scored 25.7 on a 10.07 projection, Drake Maye 23.8, and Kyle Pitts, acquired from Send Nudes on Oct. 14, scored 23.0 on a 7.58 projection in his first game for ClutchJuice. Rashod Bateman started and scored 0.0; he is now listed out with a shoulder injury.

Harold Fannin scored 1.9 in the flex while Brenton Strange scored 9.4 on the bench. CJ Donaldson, bought from brimley for $3 on Friday, started and scored 1.9. Isaiah Likely scored 23.9 and Jayden Daniels 21.0. Sheev's best lineup was 145.18, which would still have lost.

Jalon Daniels, a $0 waiver claim on Thursday, scored 13.16 at superflex. Bo Nix scored 4.48 and the two starting running backs combined for 2.2, while Omar Cooper scored 22.3 on the bench.
Hours after the game, Panic Trade Project traded Tucker, its leading scorer this season with 78.5 points, to brimley, the team it is tied with for sixth.

Brian Thomas started and scored 0.0 while Jaylin Noel scored 20.7 on the bench, and Cam Ward scored 7.78 at superflex while Geno Smith scored 12.98 on the bench. Those two swaps make it 112.24 to 108.04. Nico Collins scored 10.9 on an 18.25 projection. George Kittle, at 17.9, was the top scorer. stories.headline: The Bench Went 4-0 This Week
paragraphs: Four teams lost this week with a winning lineup sitting on their own roster. Jackie aCHANe lost by 0.14 with Bryce Lance's 8.9 on the bench. Very Naughty Boys lost by 0.54 with J.J. McCarthy's 17.32 on the bench. #StopAsianHate started Cam Skattebo at superflex for 0.0 with Blake Corum's 14.0 on the bench. God Bless Vodka started Brian Thomas for 0.0 with Jaylin Noel's 20.7 on the bench. If the bench were a team, it would be 4-0, and it would be better managed than most of you.

Send Nudes played without Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase, Jahmyr Gibbs and Tyler Warren, started Kirk Cousins, and won. Its best possible lineup was 118.34. It scored 118.34. That's two perfect lineups in a row. The champion isn't the best team in this league on paper anymore, but its lineup calls haven't missed in two weeks, and this week that was worth exactly 0.14 points.

Very Naughty Boys, I need to talk to you. You put up your best score of the season, 114.42. You paid $35 for Tanner McKee and started him over J.J. McCarthy, and McCarthy outscored him by 4.72. You lost by 0.54. Then, the same Monday, you traded a 2027 fourth for a 31-year-old running back, started him, and got 2.7. You're 0-6 and you own three 2027 firsts. Act like it. Sell the veterans. Don't buy them.

Ben Football Team is 5-1. Ben is seventh in points. Ben's last two wins came by 4.56 and 0.54. Ben has the best luck rating in the league at +2.36. Somewhere a four-leaf clover is filing a missing persons report.

Panic Trade Project's Tre Tucker scored 26.7 on Sunday, the most on its roster and the best game of his season. A few hours later Panic Trade Project traded him to brimley, the team it is tied with at 3-3 for the last playoff spot, for Jonathon Brooks, a running back who hasn't scored a point since Week 2 and is on NFL injured reserve. The team name was a warning label, and I respect a franchise that lives its brand.

Jeff Longwood went 5-1, and his upset of the week, brimley over #StopAsianHate, came in. His lock, Bijan Your Face by 92.9, won by 33.62, which only counts as a lock if you don't read the number. Week 7 games to circle: Bijan Your Face, 6-0, against Jackie aCHANe, 4-2, and brimley against Stroke The Post, the team that just traded for Tucker against the team with the highest score of the week.

breakdown.headline: 1-5, the Worst Luck in the League, and Up to Third
p: Sheev is 1-5 and third in dynasty value, up three spots to 69,030. Both numbers are correct. The team scores 150.4 a game, fifth in the league, against the third-toughest schedule. Its all-play record is 3.82 wins and its luck factor is -2.82, the worst in the league. Put this lineup against the league average every week and it's closer to 4-2.

The value gain is real and mostly cheap. Isaiah Likely (3,341) gained 546 and C.J. Stroud (4,466) gained 542. The waiver wire added three players: Tank Dell (1,243) for $1 after Panic Trade Project dropped him, Courtland Sutton (1,178) for $11 and Roschon Johnson (614) for $5. Harold Fannin Jr. lost 311.

It's a young roster. Forty-eight percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, 2% is in players 29 or older, and the weighted age is 24.9. It has three starting-caliber quarterbacks in Brock Purdy (6,268), Jayden Daniels (5,505) and Stroud, plus Tetairoa McMillan (4,860), Luther Burden III (3,369) and Jordyn Tyson on the taxi squad.

The problem is the 2027 first. Sheev's own pick belongs to Very Naughty Boys, and at 1-5 it projects early, worth 5,103. Its 2028 first belongs to ClutchJuice. In exchange, Sheev holds Ben Football Team's 2027 first (projected late), #StopAsianHate's 2028 first and second, and Bijan's 2028 third, 7,296 in pick value, seventh.
breakdown.verdict: A good young roster having a bad-luck season, and every loss makes Very Naughty Boys' pick better.
breakdown.move: Keep buying, because losing doesn't help Sheev. Trade one of the three quarterbacks for a starting running back so Breece Hall's quad stops deciding the week.

breakdown.headline: 1-5 and Rebuilding, but the First-Round Picks Belong to Someone Else
p: God Bless Vodka is 1-5 with five straight losses, scores 103.7 a game, ninth, and fell two spots to 11th in dynasty value at 50,653. The projected win total is 3.6.

The diagnosis is the draft capital. God Bless Vodka's 2027 first and second belong to Bijan, and its 2028 first and fourth belong to Jackie aCHANe. With this record, that 2027 first projects early, and Bijan is the one who gets it. What's left: its own 2027 third, its own 2028 second and third, and Jackie aCHANe's 2028 second, 4,948 in pick value, 11th.

The roster is in mixed health. Jeremiyah Love (5,291), 21, is the most valuable player on the roster and is out with his ankle again. Omarion Hampton (3,310) and Justin Herbert (3,921) are on the bench during the Chargers' bye. Nico Collins (4,531), 27, and George Kittle (2,878), 33, are veterans on a team that won't contend this year. Jaylin Noel gained 338 this week; Chase Brown lost 320.
On Monday it sold Austin Ekeler to Very Naughty Boys for a 2027 fourth. Forty-four percent of the value is in players 25 or younger.
breakdown.verdict: A rebuild without its own first-round picks, which means losing doesn't help it.
breakdown.move: Sell Kittle and Collins now, for 2027 firsts from contenders. Losing only helps Bijan.

breakdown.headline: Gibbs and Chase Sat Out, and the Champs Still Project 155
p: Here's what I'm hearing around the league: nobody wants to see Send Nudes in December. The defending champs are 4-1, second in dynasty value at 74,056 and second in player value at 67,168. They score 188.2 a game, second only to Bijan Your Face. In Weeks 4 and 5 they beat every other team in the league, and they put up 248.7 in Week 5.

This week they did it without their three most valuable players. Jahmyr Gibbs (10,947), Ja'Marr Chase (8,804) and Joe Burrow (6,413) are all on bye, and the lineup still projects 155.9. Puka Nacua (8,396) and Kyren Williams (4,507) carry it.

The front office sold Kyle Pitts to ClutchJuice on Wednesday for Ben Football Team's 2027 third and $90 of FAAB. On Friday it spent $7 of that on Christian Kirk. Send Nudes now has $110 of FAAB, the most in the league by $14. That's the insurance policy for a roster with four starters on the injury report this week.

And it needs one. Value-weighted age is 28.2, the oldest in the league, and 38% of the value sits in players 30 or older: Derrick Henry is 32, Mike Evans 33, Kirk Cousins 38 and Aaron Rodgers 42. Baker Mayfield and Deebo Samuel are on IR. The champs don't own their 2027 first or second, which belong to Very Naughty Boys. They do hold their own 2028 first, second and third, plus two 2027 thirds. Pick value is 6,888, eighth in the league.
breakdown.verdict: The best team in the league not named Bijan, built on old players and the biggest waiver budget in the league.
breakdown.move: Use the $110 when the next injury hits, and sell one of Henry, Evans or Cousins at the deadline while they still score.

breakdown.headline: More Value in Picks Than Players, and a Quarterback Who Scored 28 on Thursday
p: ClutchJuice is 2-4, scores 91.0 a game, 11th, and is 10th in dynasty value at 51,614. The number that matters: its picks are worth 27,137, the most in the league, and its players are worth 24,477. No other team in the league has picks worth more than its roster.

The roster is built around Drake Maye (7,157), 24, who scored 28.44 on Thursday. Germie Bernard (2,362) gained 537 this week and Kyle Pitts Sr. (2,221) gained 337. Eighty-seven percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, the highest share in the league. On Tuesday it added Anthony Richardson Sr. (849) from Very Naughty Boys for its 2028 fifth-round pick.

Here's the pick list. In 2027: its own first (projected early, 5,103), brimley's and #StopAsianHate's firsts (both projected mid), its own, Panic Trade Project's and Jackie aCHANe's seconds, and #StopAsianHate's and Very Naughty Boys' thirds. In 2028: its own first and Sheev's first, its own second, and its own and brimley's thirds.
The projected win total is 2.6, which is fine. Every loss improves the 2027 first.
breakdown.verdict: The league's biggest pick stash, a starting quarterback, and not much else yet.
breakdown.move: Turn two of the three 2027 firsts into one young running back or receiver who's already producing. Three firsts in one draft is more than one roster can use.

breakdown.headline: The Toughest Schedule in the League, and Up to Fourth
p: brimley is 3-3 after two straight wins, scores 151.4 a game, fourth, and has faced 165.5 a game, the toughest schedule in the league. Its luck factor is -1.0. Dynasty value rose to 68,156, up one spot to fourth, and the projected win total is 8.6.

Malik Nabers (6,798), 23, is the most valuable player on the roster and gained 651 this week. Trey McBride (6,571) lost 500 and MarShawn Lloyd lost 438. Justin Jefferson (6,424) and two starting quarterbacks, Trevor Lawrence (5,973, on bye) and Jordan Love (4,682), round out the top.

One trade since last Sunday. On Monday night brimley sent Jonathon Brooks to Panic Trade Project for Tre Tucker (1,476), who starts this week. It also has Kendre Miller (947), an $8 pickup on Oct. 16. Saquon Barkley (3,084), 29, is questionable for Monday night, and DJ Moore (2,125) is out.

The draft capital is middle of the pack: its own 2027 second and third, Stroke The Post's 2027 third, its own 2028 first and second, and Sheev's 2028 third, 8,668, sixth. Its own 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice from the Bucky Irving trade. Only 23% of the value is in players 25 or younger, second-lowest in the league.
breakdown.verdict: A better team than its record, with the schedule finally easing and an older roster than the rank suggests.
breakdown.move: Buy one starter at running back with the 2028 second. Don't sell: the scoring says this is a playoff team.

breakdown.headline: Third in Luck, 10th in Scoring, and Still Holding Two 2027 Firsts
p: Panic Trade Project is 3-3, but here's what I'm hearing from the numbers: it scores 91.9 a game, 10th, and its luck factor is +1.82, third-highest. All-play says 1.18 wins. Dynasty value is 59,904, seventh, unchanged in rank, and the projected win total is 4.5.

The roster is the youngest kind of rebuild. Eighty-three percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, nobody valued is 29 or older, and the weighted age is 24.0. Travis Hunter gained 678 this week, Omar Cooper Jr. 499 and Jalen Coker 444. Jaxson Dart (4,061) is on IR and Emeka Egbuka (3,438) is out with a concussion.

The moves were busy. On Monday night it sent Tre Tucker to brimley for Jonathon Brooks (1,318, IR). It dropped Tank Dell for Jalon Daniels, then dropped Daniels for Joe Milton ($8), and Dell went to Sheev for $1. It also picked up Chig Okonkwo for $0. This week it starts Kaleb Johnson at 0.23 projected and Marvin Harrison Jr. at 3.52, which tells you how thin the healthy depth is.

The draft capital is the real asset: its own 2027 first (projected mid) and Stroke The Post's 2027 first (projected late), Sheev's and Ben Football Team's 2027 seconds, its own 2028 first, second and third, Stroke's 2028 second and Jackie aCHANe's 2028 third. That's 16,405, third in the league. Its own 2027 second belongs to ClutchJuice.
breakdown.verdict: A young, pick-rich rebuild whose 3-3 record is mostly luck.
breakdown.move: Sell the record. Any contender that wants Bo Nix or Coker should pay in 2027 picks while Panic still looks like a .500 team.

breakdown.headline: Two Quarterbacks Down and No First-Round Picks
p: #StopAsianHate is 2-3 and fourth in dynasty value at 67,068, down one spot. The scoring is better than the record: 152.7 a game, sixth, against the second-toughest schedule in the league, 165.7 a game. Its luck factor of -1.45 is second-worst, behind only Sheev.

The diagnosis this week is at quarterback. Lamar Jackson (6,575) is out with his ankle injury again. Jalen Hurts (3,818) is on IR with a blood clot in his calf, which is a different kind of problem from a sprain. Deshaun Watson is the only healthy quarterback on the roster, and he starts in a Cleveland offense implied for about 18.

The rest of the roster is in good shape. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (9,625), 24, is the most valuable player on the roster and scored 25.4 on Thursday. Kenneth Walker (6,855), Zay Flowers (4,779) and George Pickens (4,170) are all 26 or younger. Rashee Rice is out with hamstring and knee injuries, and Ladd McConkey (2,920) was cleared for the week but sits on the bench.

The draft capital is thin. #StopAsianHate's 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice, and its 2028 first and second belong to Sheev. It holds its own 2027 second, two 2027 thirds (ClutchJuice's and Jackie aCHANe's), and its 2028 third. Pick value is 4,906, ninth.
breakdown.verdict: A strong skill-position core with no healthy starting quarterback and no first-round picks to buy one.
breakdown.move: Trade from receiver depth, McConkey or Rice, for a second starting quarterback before the bye weeks pile up.

breakdown.headline: Six Wins, the Most Valuable Player in the League, and a First From God Bless Vodka
p: Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 is 6-0, the last unbeaten team, and first in dynasty value at 91,566. The gap to second-place Send Nudes is 17,941, which is about the value of Bijan Robinson and Brock Bowers combined. It scores 184.8 a game, best in the league, and its projected win total is now 13.5.

The roster is built at the top. Josh Allen (10,740) is the most valuable player in the league, and he's on the bench this week only because Buffalo has a bye. Bijan Robinson (10,074), 24, Bowers (7,666), 23, and Ashton Jeanty (5,617), 22, give it three young cornerstones. Amon-Ra St. Brown (7,489) gained 558 in value since last Sunday. The losses were at the edges: Davante Adams (IR) fell 682 and Michael Wilson 464.
Age is the one thing to watch. Thirty percent of the value is in players 29 or older: Allen and Christian McCaffrey are both 30.4, and Dak Prescott is 33.3. Only 34% is 25 or younger.

The draft capital covers it. Bijan holds God Bless Vodka's 2027 first, and with God Bless Vodka at 1-5, it currently projects early and is worth 5,103. It also has God Bless Vodka's 2027 second, its own 2028 first and second, and Ben Football Team's 2028 first and third. Its own 2027 first belongs to Jackie aCHANe. Pick value is 13,753, fifth. This week it spent $13 on Michael Mayer and $6 on Ryan Flournoy for depth.
breakdown.verdict: The best team in the league now, and an early first from a struggling team to restock later.
breakdown.move: Nothing big. Use the God Bless Vodka first or the Ben 2028 first to get younger at running back behind McCaffrey before his value falls further.

breakdown.headline: 0-6, Three 2027 Firsts, and a Tight End Who Just Got More Targets
p: Very Naughty Boys is 0-6, scores 86.0 a game, last, and projects for 0.8 wins. Clinically, that's the plan working. Dynasty value rose 2,262 to 56,246, eighth.

Three trades in two days this week. It sent Anthony Richardson Sr. to ClutchJuice for a 2028 fifth, sent Chris Godwin Jr. and Justin Fields to Ben Football Team for Dontayvion Wicks, and added Austin Ekeler from God Bless Vodka for a 2027 fourth. Wicks is out this week with an ankle injury. J.J. McCarthy gained 994 in value and Colston Loveland (3,955) gained 549. Loveland scored 19.9 on Thursday, and Cole Kmet's knee injury could make him Chicago's only real tight end.
Sixty-five percent of the value is in players 25 or younger. Fernando Mendoza (3,990) on the taxi squad is the most valuable player on the roster.

The draft capital is the second-best in the league at 22,515. Very Naughty Boys holds three 2027 firsts: its own and Sheev's, both projected early at 5,103 each, and Send Nudes' (projected late). It also holds Send Nudes', Bijan's and its own 2027 seconds, plus its own 2028 first, second and third. Its own 2027 third belongs to ClutchJuice.
breakdown.verdict: The cleanest tank in the league, with two early firsts and a third that's late.
breakdown.move: Keep selling veterans for picks. Package the Send Nudes first with a second to move up if a top quarterback prospect is there.

breakdown.headline: Up in Value, Down Three Spots, and Still Built for Right Now
p: Stroke The Post is 4-2, scores 171.1 a game, third in the league, and projects for 10.5 wins. Its dynasty score went up, from 67,226 to 68,020, and it still fell from third to sixth. That says more about the middle of the table than about this roster: third through sixth are now separated by 1,010 points, Sheev at 69,030 down to Stroke at 68,020.

This week's movement was mostly good. Jonathan Taylor (6,224) gained 765, Caleb Williams (7,308) gained 450 and D'Andre Swift gained 347. Drake London (5,290) lost 504. The core is CeeDee Lamb (6,656), Taylor, James Cook III (5,319, on the bench during Buffalo's bye), London, Chris Olave (5,027) and Garrett Wilson (4,467).

The catch is age. Only 17% of Stroke's value is in players 25 or younger, the lowest share in the league, and the weighted age is 27.5, second-oldest. Matthew Stafford, 38, is still a starting quarterback here.

The draft capital is thin. Stroke holds its own 2027 second, its own 2028 first and its own 2028 third, 4,975 in pick value, 10th. Its 2027 first and 2028 second belong to Panic Trade Project from the Rome Odunze trade.
breakdown.verdict: A real contender with a 41-point head start this week and very little behind the starters.
breakdown.move: Ride it. If the team is still 6-2 or better after Week 8, trade the 2028 first for a younger receiver, not for another veteran.

breakdown.headline: 5-1, the Luckiest Team in the League, and One Draft Pick Left
p: Ben Football Team is 5-1 and 12th in dynasty value at 42,362. Here's what I'm hearing from the scoring: 125.4 a game, seventh, against the third-softest schedule, 111.2 a game. All-play says 2.64 wins. The luck factor is +2.36, the highest in the league. The projected win total is still 8.6, because five wins are already in the bank.

It went for it again on Tuesday, adding Chris Godwin Jr. (1,218) and Justin Fields (359) from Very Naughty Boys for Dontayvion Wicks. Godwin starts this week with Baker Mayfield expected back. Patrick Mahomes (5,535) lost 382 in value this week; Rashid Shaheed gained 358 and DK Metcalf (2,004) gained 312.
The roster is old where it counts. Mahomes is 31 and Jared Goff 32, and 30% of the value is in players 29 or older. Sam LaPorta (3,499) and Bhayshul Tuten (3,483) are the young pieces.

The draft capital is gone. Ben holds one pick in the first three rounds of 2027 and 2028: its own 2028 second, 1,389, last in the league. Its 2027 first belongs to Sheev, its 2027 second to Panic Trade Project, its 2027 third to Send Nudes, and its 2028 first and third to Bijan.
breakdown.verdict: A real playoff team on paper, a much weaker one by the scoring, and no picks left to fix it.
breakdown.move: Stop buying. Any more veterans cost picks Ben doesn't have. Play out the season and hope the luck holds.

breakdown.headline: 4-2 on the Softest Schedule, and Two 2027 Firsts in the Drawer
p: Jackie aCHANe is 4-2 and rose two spots to ninth in dynasty value, 52,504. The scoring is 112.8 a game, eighth. It has faced 86.7 a game, the softest schedule in the league, and its luck factor is +2.0, second-highest. All-play says 2.0 wins. The projected win total is 6.4.

The value gain came from Matthew Golden (4,011), who gained 668. Terry McLaurin, 31, lost 589. De'Von Achane (3,969) is on IR with an ACL injury. The quarterback room is deep, if not great: Bryce Young (4,518), Kyler Murray, Malik Willis and Daniel Jones. This week it added Zonovan Knight for $3 with Jeremiyah Love out in Arizona, and Knight starts.

The draft capital is fourth in the league at 15,380: its own 2027 first (projected mid) and Bijan's (projected late), three 2027 thirds (Sheev's, Panic Trade Project's and Bijan's), its own 2028 first, God Bless Vodka's 2028 first and Sheev's 2028 second. Its own 2028 second belongs to God Bless Vodka.
Last week it lost to Send Nudes by 0.14. This week it gets Bijan. Thirty percent of the value is in players 25 or younger.
breakdown.verdict: A middling roster with a lucky record and good picks. The picks are the future here.
breakdown.move: Sell high while 4-2 still means something. Murray and Willis have value to a contender that needs a quarterback.

dynasty.method: Dynasty score = market value of every rostered player plus draft picks. Player values come from FantasyCalc's superflex, 12-team PPR dynasty market, which covers about 400 players and already prices in age; deeper depth players get a small estimate by years in the league. Pick values also come from FantasyCalc, with 2027 firsts valued early, mid or late by the original owner's current standing. Rosters and pick ownership come straight from Sleeper. Updated with each Sunday Edition. Projected wins add the current record to 9 remaining games, played at a rate that blends all-play win rate with a strength score (half points per game, half this week's lineup projection).

tradeGrades.headline: Very Naughty Boys Clears Out the Quarterback Room
tradeGrades.intro: Two new trades since Tuesday's edition, both on Tuesday afternoon, and Very Naughty Boys is in both. First it sent Anthony Richardson Sr. to ClutchJuice for ClutchJuice's 2028 fifth-round pick. About 12 minutes later it traded Chris Godwin Jr. and Justin Fields to Ben Football Team for Dontayvion Wicks. I grade every trade three ways: value, fit and timing. Value is market price, using FantasyCalc's dynasty values for players and the same pick values as our Dynasty Rankings. Winning on value with the wrong timeline is still a bad trade. The three older trades keep the values and grades from the editions that graded them.

trades.title: Godwin and Fields to Ben Football Team

sides.reason: Ben Football Team won on market value by 378, Godwin at 1,142 and Fields at 276 for Wicks at 1,040. The fit is mixed. Godwin starts this week at 9.7 projected, but he averaged 7.7 in six starts for Very Naughty Boys, while Wicks averaged 9.8 in five starts for Ben. Fields is Kansas City's backup, and Ben starts Patrick Mahomes, so in superflex he's a sensible handcuff; Ben released Jameis Winston a minute after the trade. The timing works: Ben is 5-1 and 12th in dynasty value, so this is a team cashing in a season it's actually winning.

Very Naughty Boys gave up 378 in market value and got five years younger at receiver. For an 0-6 team that is eighth in dynasty value and owns three 2027 first-round picks, younger is the right direction, and Godwin's value only drops from here at 30. Wicks starts Monday night against Dallas at 6.35 projected. The knock is the price: it handed a contender a starter and a quarterback handcuff for a smaller return.

ClutchJuice paid a 2028 fifth-round pick for a 24-year-old quarterback worth 697. In superflex, that's about as cheap as a quarterback lottery ticket gets. Drake Maye is its only starting quarterback, and this week it has running back Demond Claiborne in the superflex slot at 0.64 projected. Richardson is Indianapolis's backup and has no Week 7 projection, so he doesn't fix that yet. At 2-4 and 11th in dynasty value, buying a young quarterback is the right move for this team.

FantasyCalc doesn't price fifth-round picks; its 2028 fourth is worth 845, so this pick is worth less than that. Richardson was a backup with no projection, and Very Naughty Boys still has Sam Darnold and Tanner McKee starting, so it didn't lose a lineup piece. But a rebuilding superflex team should be buying 24-year-old quarterbacks, not selling them for a fifth. Twelve minutes later it traded Fields too.

brimley gave up 90 in market value, Brooks at 1,407 for Tucker at 1,317, and that is close to even. The fit is strong: Romeo Doubs is on brimley's IR and DJ Moore is listed out, and Tucker scored 26.7 on Sunday and 78.5 in six starts this season. Brooks never scored for brimley and is on NFL injured reserve with an abdomen injury, per Sleeper. A 3-3 team holding sixth place turned a player it couldn't use into a starter, and took him from the team it is tied with.

Panic Trade Project won on value by 90 and got two years younger, which fits its rebuild ranking, seventh in dynasty value. The timing is the problem. It is 3-3, tied with brimley for the last playoff spot, and it sold its leading scorer to brimley hours after his best game, for a running back who can't play right now. Choosing to rebuild is fine. Doing it by strengthening the one team you are chasing, for a player you can't start, is a C.

Very Naughty Boys paid a pick worth 877 for a running back worth 531, a 346-point loss. Ekeler started immediately and scored 2.7 in a 0.54-point loss. The team is 0-6, ranks eighth in dynasty value and owns three 2027 first-round picks, so its window is next year, not a 31-year-old's last season. Because it is 0-6, its own fourth is likely to fall early in the round, which makes the price higher than the market average.

God Bless Vodka claimed Ekeler for $4 on Oct. 4. He scored 5.0 and 2.4 on its bench, and it sold him for a pick worth 877 and a 346-point gain in market value. At 1-5 and 11th in dynasty value, God Bless Vodka should be selling veterans, and this pick comes from the league's only winless team. It's a small deal, but it's done right.

Sheev paid $3 of FAAB for a rookie running back worth 188, and brimley had claimed him for $0 two days earlier. The fit makes sense with Breece Hall and Kyle Monangai out and both starting backs questionable, but Donaldson projects 3.71 this week. Sheev released Dohnte Meyers, a $25 claim, the same afternoon. It's a cheap move, but a team with $27 left is paying a premium for a player who went for $0 on waivers two days earlier.

brimley turned a free waiver claim into $3 of FAAB in two days, and gave up nothing it was using. To get Donaldson it released Tyler Higbee, whom Ben Football Team then claimed. The stakes are tiny, but it's clean business by a team with $82 of FAAB left.
